message: サリーちゃんの談合
After school. There's a commotion coming from the school gate.

name: Sally
message: 「We're here, Prez!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, you, couldn't wait」
I see, that makes sense.

name: Synn
message: 「Come on in. Welcome to the Student Council room」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, how can you stay so calm walking around with these people?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's way easier on the nerves than speaking up on a stage」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Make up your mind whether you've got nerves of steel or you're just completely careless!」

name: Ria
message: 「Would you like some ohagi?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the food!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, I was the one who got that! Don't take it, you stupid angel!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ohagi, good. Thanks」
He's surprisingly polite for someone of his huge build.

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Feed me, more」
Never mind, he's totally shameless.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, what should we do from here?」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean 'what should we do'? If they get hungry, they're just going to pull the same stunt as before, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「I already ate curry, so I'm totally fine!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Sally-chan, unfair. You, feed me」

name: Sally
message: 「Th-th-th-that's why! Please lend a helping hand for poor, starving Boss here!」
If we leave them unchecked, they might end up eating not just the food, but us too.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Lolotte, first off, could you explain how the economy works in this world to these two?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, sir!」
Two minutes later.

name: Sally
message: 「Gwooo~~~. Zzz~~~...」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Is that, tasty?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. This isn't compulsory education, so if you have no intention of studying, I'd like you to go home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go home... to her hideout?」

name: Ria
message: 「To the Demon World, maybe」

name: Sally
message: 「A-A-A-A-Anything but that! I went through all that trouble to come to the Human World, so cut me some slack!」

name: Misa
message: 「Coming to the Human World just to eat delicious food... Are all Demons like this?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph! Don't lump us gourmets in with those dimwits who are slaves to their three basic desires!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, a guest?」

name: Ria
message: 「At least stop tickling me when we have a guest!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heya, Chairwoman」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, well. You've reeled in quite the big catch again~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently, she's one of the so-called Seven Demon Generals」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, that's amazing! Colluding with a Demon executive--what kind of backroom deal did you strike?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-What a shady way to put it...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it was--」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Big Sis. You have to choose your words properly when you speak」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Smooth peace negotiations--truly a bloodless Tulip Revolution, as it were」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't complicate things」

name: Helena
message: 「In short, she has to do something in order to fill her stomach」

name: Synn
message: 「You do get it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I believe it is difficult for a mere student, who isn't even a business owner, to hire someone without any capital」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That actually sounds pretty reasonable」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. By the way, what is a business owner?」

name: Helena
message: 「I see. So you're looking for a potential sponsor, then」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't ask you to go that far to look after us. After all, this is the duty of the Student Council--no, of the Crusaders」

name: Helena
message: 「'My role isn't just to drive them away'... huh.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you want to fill your belly, first you have to work and earn money. Let's see, why don't you try getting a part-time job?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Part-time job?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm doin' prosti-work at the Prez's house, prosti-work!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're going to say that, it's 'housekeeper'\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, you're just a freeloader」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, part-time job?」

name: Misa
message: 「But we're talking about a Demon here. I really doubt there's any shop willing to hire him――」

name: Helena
message: 「In that case, why don't you all arrange something for him?」

name: Synn
message: 「Us?」

name: Helena
message: 「For example, Synn-chan. Someone like \{you|\s12\s12\s12} might be able to pull a few strings, wouldn't you say?」

name: Sally
message: 「What a dummy~ You don't even get something this simple? Well, I don't get it either.」
So Helena-san sees right through everything, huh...
I wonder if she knows about Macaron too...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I see! Because he's the Student Council President, he can somehow cover things up using his power and authority!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, let's go with that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood. I'll figure something out.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. I don't think you're making an empty promise, but... are you really going to be okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just have to do it.」
Still, the milk delivery job is a no-go. He'd break the bicycle.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Easier said than worrying about it, harder done!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which one is it?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, making him work right away when he doesn't even know how money works is... well, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「Even so, this boy really is huge~. He stands out way too much」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Her boobs are huge too, just like Senpai's」

name: Helena
message: 「This one is just plain fat. Don't lump her together with the cute and sexy Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「She stands out......」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. How about we hire her in the Student Council first?」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought about that too, but we don't have the money to pay her」

name: Ria
message: 「If there's a purpose, we can allocate a budget, right? Besides, right now there's......」

name: Misa
message: 「The Kirakira Festival!」

name: Ria
message: 「Right. So with this little Eauderourke--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, hmm. I see, that's a brilliant idea! Nanaka...... can you spare a bit of budget from our current allocations?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if we can't, I'll make it happen. Leave it to little ol' Nanaka!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems they've decided on something. Good for you, Extra-san」

name: Sally
message: 「Aren't you angels basically extras around here too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Before you start working, there's something you need to keep in mind. That is perseverance...... what you'd call endurance!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And so we go with a sandwich-board advertiser」
We tried sandwiching Eauderourke's massive body between signboards.

name: Synn
message: 「Wear this and take a lap around Ryuusei Town」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「That's it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's it. Easy, right? So, how far can we stretch the meal allowance?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it's just one beef bowl...... somehow!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Beef bowl!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So she's serving as Ryuusei Academy's walking billboard, then」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, it's for an event, so people will just think she's in a mascot costume--nothing to worry about」

name: Sally
message: 「No fair, no fair. I wanna eat a beef bowl too」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, work together and have them share it with you」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, I'll do that~\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Cleverly tricking them to double your workforce without increasing your capital--truly impressive, Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「You're so twisted. Truly impressive, O Great Sage」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Ode, work hard. Beef bowl, feed me」

name: Synn
message: 「If you cause any trouble, the contract is void immediately, got it?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Beef bowl, can eat. Holding back, no problem」

name: Ria
message: 「Have a safe tri~p♪」
Now then, let's get to work ourselves!
